text:
ara: Heads up — our ephemeral inspect sampler in prod canary just returned an unredacted snippet. Not huge but contains an email-like string.
micah: ugh. which canary?
dina: noticed it in the 03:10 canary for route 'customer-inspect'. I flagged it and captured a sample.
ara: thanks. sample looks like `user@example.com` in response body. attached in #priv-audit.
samir: quick question — was this from the new temporary-unmask toggle we shipped last week?
ara: yes, the toggle `inspect-unmask` was enabled for the canary cohort (10% tenants) to validate end-to-end traceability.
jules: do we have a fast rollback path? we should flip the toggle and maybe disable the sampler for that route.
ara: propose: 1) flip `inspect-unmask` off for canary 2) set sampler rate to 0 for customer-inspect 3) create a rollback runbook entry.
micah: agree. ops-bot, can you flip the feature off for prod canary?
ops-bot: Received request from @micah. Running: `redwoodctl feature toggle inspect-unmask --env=prod --cohort=canary --state=off`
deploy-bot: Feature toggle change applied (canary cohort) — audit id: 0ab3f.
dar: (oops typo, meant dina) — sampler rate endpoint is `POST /internal/sampler/rate` with body { "route": "customer-inspect", "rate": 0 }`.
samir: hold on — if we set sampler to 0 we lose the ability to investigate future regressions. can we instead set a stricter scrub policy with immediate redaction for email/phone?
ara: scrub policy change would take longer to rollout. toggle off is fastest mitigation. we can snapshot current samples for investigation and then re-enable a reduced, hashed-sampling later.
jules: two quick followups: (a) required approvals for a prod toggle rollback? (b) telemetry event we should emit so SRE/REDACT audit sees it.
micah: (a) ops can toggle for incident mitigation w/ postmortem, (b) ops-bot will emit `audit.feature_toggle` event.
ops-bot: Emitted event `audit.feature_toggle` { action: "toggle_off", feature: "inspect-unmask", actor: "micah", cohort: "canary" }
dina: i'm taking a snapshot of currently stored ephemeral captures -> uploading to secure bucket `s3://redwood-priv-audit/canary-1758887776/` and will restrict access to legal+sec+eng.
samir: good. then we should add a short-term circuit-breaker to prevent future unmasking for any route flagged as PII-sensitive. proposed rule: if route.meta.sensitivity == "high" then force-scrub.
ara: agree. who owns the circuit-breaker implementation? eng-runtime or eng-platform?
micah: eng-runtime to enforce at runtime hooks, eng-platform to supply route metadata and console toggle UX.
jules: i'll create an RFC and link the owner tags. also need a console UX change: a warning banner when enabling unmask toggles that lists required approvals and shows sample retention policy.
ara: small ops command to flip sampler now?
dina: running curl now: ```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/sampler/rate \\  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN' \\  -d '{"route":"customer-inspect","rate":0}'
```
ops-bot: Sampler rate update accepted. new rate=0 for route=customer-inspect.
micah: good. next steps: 1) write short incident note for oncall 2) add circuit-breaker ticket 3) schedule scrub-policy rollout 4) add console warning UX story.
samir: add telemetry event `telemetry.sampler.change` with reason=security-mitigation.
ops-bot: Emitted event `telemetry.sampler.change` { route: "customer-inspect", old_rate: 0.05, new_rate: 0, reason: "security-mitigation" }
jules: filing tickets now — linking: https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/7788 (circuit-breaker), https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/7789 (console-ux).
ara: thanks everyone. action owners: dina (snapshot + legal handoff), micah (postmortem + runbook), jules (RFC + tickets), samir (scrub/circuit design).
micah: i'm drafting the postmortem in docs/incident/1758887776-ephemeral-unmask.md and will ping sec/legal when complete.
ara: quick note: let's also add a non-blocking telemetry sample that stores only hashed identifiers (sha256) for investigation instead of raw values — stopgap until scrub policy ships.
samir: agreed. hashed-sampling will be implemented as `prefix-hash` transform in the sampler pipeline. will prototype tomorrow.
ara: closing thread once tickets are created. thx :thumbsup:
